verdict.rationale: Conductor explicitly supports starting a workspace from a GitHub issue (or PR/branch) and letting an agent work autonomously—testing, running builds, and updating scripts without confirmation—then surfaces PR comments and failing-check logs, suggesting a working PR is opened for review (conductor-docs-12, conductor-docs-17, conductor-docs-11). However, no first-party or community evidence explicitly confirms the agent automatically opens/submits the pull request at the end of the flow, and community threads focus on git-worktree/workspace mechanics rather than the issue-to-PR pipeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on confirmation that Conductor auto-creates/pushes the pull request from an issue-derived workspace, and community corroboration of the full issue→PR loop.
